name: Shanghai Kinetic Medical Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Kinetic Medical Co., Ltd operates as an international producer and distributor of medical equipment, serving both the domestic Chinese market and global clients. Its extensive product portfolio caters to a range of medical specialties, including orthopedics, cardiovascular care, and sports medicine. Among its key offerings is the primom spinal fixation system, a sophisticated suite of instruments and implants engineered to address contemporary spinal deformities, degenerative conditions, and traumatic injuries. The company also provides kyphoplasty systems, vertebral osteotomes for creating precise cavities within vertebrae, and specialized bone cement delivery systems paired with injection guns. Furthermore, it supplies versatile tools for surgical insertion and pathway establishment, alongside kinect locking compression plate systems. The firm, established in 2005, maintains its headquarters in Shanghai, China.
